intro: Along Westfall’s western edge, Longshore’s broad sands are claimed by hostile murlocs and broken ships.

p: Longshore runs along Westfall’s western coast, a wide stretch of unbroken sand. Travelers find little peace there. Murlocs dominate the surf, with Old Murk-Eye among the feared leaders, and sunken ships, including ruined elven destroyers, lie in the shallows. Near the south, Daphne Stilwell’s isolated farm faces Defias bandits. Across the water, the Westfall Lighthouse stands within sight.
